pictures.scene: Dore, Jacob's Dream — a stair of light opening out of the night sky with winged angels coming down it one after another while Jacob lies asleep on the bare stones at the foot of it, then i saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the abyss, holding in his hand a great chain
pictures.name: pd_dore_jacobs_dream

pictures.scene: Martorell, Saint George and the Dragon — a knight in black armour on a white horse driving his lance down into the mouth of a winged dragon sprawled under the hooves, a crowned princess standing quietly at one side and a castle full of onlookers behind, he seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and satan, and bound him for a thousand years
pictures.name: pd_martorell_saint_george

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Sea of Ice — great slabs of ice heaped and tilted one over another in a frozen waste, the hull of a ship crushed and buried under the pile of them, and he threw him into the abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_sea_of_ice

pictures.scene: Apocalypse manuscript, The Vision of the Throne and the Elders — Christ enthroned in an oval of light holding a cross-staff and an open book while crowned elders sit in rows on either side of him and John stands watching from the margin, after that, he must be released for a brief period of time, then i saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_vision_of_the_throne_and_elders

pictures.scene: Gerome, The Christian Martyrs' Last Prayer — a lion walking out alone onto the sand of a packed amphitheatre under a grey sky, the tiers crowded to the top with spectators and burning torches set along the barrier, and i saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of jesus and for the word of god, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands
pictures.name: pd_gerome_martyrs

pictures.scene: Bloch, The Resurrection — Christ standing up out of the broken grave with both arms lifted and his face turned to the light, a white robe falling from his shoulders and two angels kneeling in white with their hands joined among the lilies, and they came to life and reigned with christ for a thousand years, the rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete, this is the first resurrection
pictures.name: pd_bloch_resurrection

pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Trinity — God the Father crowned in the clouds holding up the cross with the Son upon it and the dove above them, ranks of martyrs with palms on one side and popes, bishops and emperors kneeling on the other, blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection, the second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of god and of christ, and will reign with him for a thousand years
pictures.name: pd_durer_all_saints

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Peter in Prison — an old man with a white beard sitting on the floor of a dark cell with his hands folded over his knee and a single shaft of light on his face, two heavy iron keys lying in the straw beside him, when the thousand years are complete, satan will be released from his prison, and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, gog and magog, to assemble them for battle
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_peter_in_prison

pictures.scene: Snayers, The Siege of Aire sur la Lys — a walled town ringed all the way round by earthworks and trenches in the snow, columns of troops winding toward it across the white plain and a crowd of soldiers and camp followers watching from the hill in front, their number is like the sand of the seashore, and they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city
pictures.name: pd_snayers_the_siege_of_aire_sur_la_lys

pictures.scene: Patinir, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — a city burning along its whole length under a sky turned blood red, flames running the walls and towers and columns of smoke going straight up into the glare, but fire came down from heaven and consumed them, and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown
pictures.name: pd_patinir_sodom_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Last Judgement — Christ seated in a deep blue oval of light on a ground of beaten gold with his right hand raised and saints and haloed angels standing in ranks on either side, an angel below him holding up the cross, there they will be tormented day and night forever and ever, then i saw a great white throne and the one seated on it
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_last_judgement

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Limbo — Christ carrying the banner of the cross steps over the door of the cave torn off its hinges and flat on the ground, and reaches out to take the hand of a white-robed old man who comes forward out of the dark with the others crowding behind him, earth and heaven fled from his presence, and no place was found for them, and i saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_limbo

pictures.scene: Antonello da Messina, Saint Jerome in His Study — a scholar in a red robe reading at a desk set up on a wooden platform inside a great stone arch, open books propped on the shelves around him and more lying flat on the boards, a peacock on the tiled floor and a lion in the shadowed arcade behind, and there were open books, and one of them was the book of life, and the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books
pictures.name: pd_antonello_da_messina_saint_jerome_in_his_study

pictures.scene: Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — a handful of survivors clinging to the broken mast of a wrecked ship in the open sea while a huge green wave rears up over them and the sun breaks gold through the spray behind, the sea gave up its dead, and death and hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_the_ninth_wave

pictures.scene: Verschuier, The Great Fire of London — a whole city skyline on fire across the water with smoke rolling up red into the night and sparks carried over the river, boats packed with people and their bundles pulling away from the bank, then death and hades were thrown into the lake of fire, this is the second death, the lake of fire
pictures.name: pd_verschuier_fire_of_london

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, Vesuvius in Eruption — a field of molten lava glowing red and smoking along the dark shore of a bay, the moon showing through a tear in the heavy cloud above and laying a track of light on the water beyond, and if anyone was found whose name was not written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_vesuvius_in_eruption

lines.text: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss,
holding in his hand a great chain.
He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan,
and bound him for a thousand years.
And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him,
so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete.
After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.
Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge.
And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God,
and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands.
And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection!
The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,
and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to assemble them for battle.
Their number is like the sand of the seashore.
And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.
And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown.
There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it.
Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne.
And there were open books, and one of them was the Book of Life.
And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead,
and each one was judged according to his deeds.
Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire.
This is the second death, the lake of fire.
And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life,
he was thrown into the lake of fire.
